song_craft: Voice: beloved handcrafted couplets (restored 2a45bbc — the retransmission was reverted; L4 sings the loved version, never the reverted one). Stotra-arc: rite (v1) → scrutiny (vv2–4) → madness-bliss (v5) → sudden-means (v6) → riddles dissolved (vv7–10) → fixing (v11) → descent (vv12–15) → red rite (v16) → grasping goddess (vv17–20) → ordaining three (v21) → sporting ground (vv22–23) → garland (v24) → Śiva-made shining (v25) → time-making cover (v26, live-fork noted not litigated) → resort (v27) → bowing (v28) → all-folk grace (v29) → dated seal 991 CE (v30). L4 = L3 verbatim throughout, music named.

lines: Where beginnings vary and rules have melted, what taste is there, unpartitioned,
full past compare? Self's light-yoke is one with all that is; floods unopposed, knowing supreme, past price.
l4.sanskrit_cite: vicitrārambhatve galitaniyame yaḥ kila rasaḥ | sakalabhavabhāvaikamayatāviruddhair dharmaughaiḥ paracitir anarghocitaguṇā

verses.craft: Unopposed-floods per SD over print (sense-requires); priceless close.
verses.reads: argmap Q+INF (+UNC ['aviruddhair SD over print viruddhair (sense requires unopposed).']) / C1 essence / rasa adbhuta of priceless taste / L2+L3 voice (handcrafted, restored)
